🚨 Loan Extended! 🚨

After his initial 1 month loan was due to come to an end after this Saturdays game away to Bilston, we can now confirm the Dan Clarksons loan from Chasetown has been extended for the foreseeable future!

Dan came into the squad on the eve of the season, and has slotted straight in. Dan has started all 8 games so far, scoring 1 goal and earning 1 opposition Player of the Match. 

We would like to thank Chasetown for extending the loan and we look forward to seeing Dan continue his impressive start in a Stafford Town shirt!
